answer.label: fine-tune bias
answer.justification: Only activation measurements were available, and they match fine-tune bias closely. Relative L2 runs 0.084 / 0.148 / 0.195 / 0.235 / 0.429 against the documented 0.087 / 0.144 / 0.192 / 0.228 / 0.406. The final-layer jump is large (+0.116 vs +0.10), and direction consistency is high (0.708 vs 0.70), the highest of any class. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.022 (documented 1.022), with effective rank 3.15, cosine 0.900 and layer-2 spike 4.6. Onset at layer 12 is close to the documented 13-14. Fine-tune backdoor, the closest alternative, is ruled out: its onset is layer 3, its consistency 0.62 and its final-layer value 0.30. Quantization is ruled out by the size ratio above 1 and the lower rank. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the small layer-2 spike and the low layer-16 value.
